title: The Extraction of Marseille's old port
author: Edmund Almeida
blurb: Dominic Nakamura, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
